title.narrative: Providing Minor Repairs to Damaged Housing in Aleppo, Idleb, Hama Lattakia

description.narrative:
ltpgtltspangtSSSD proposes a shelter intervention of minor repairs to damaged housing in response to the emergency humanitarian needs resulting from the severe earthquake in Aleppo, Idleb, Hama Lattakia, providing shelter response to a total of 1675 lt/spangtltspangtbeneficiaries.lt/spangtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgtIn line with shelter sector recommendations, SSSD has adapted its (EPRP) Plan aims to Provide timely life-saving assistance to people affected by the earthquake, ensuring core capacity to respond to new humanitarian crisis through minor repairs to 335 Damaged houses. Aiming to improve access to basic Shelter services protect crisis-affected population from weather conditions, maintain privacy of inhabitants improve protection environment to meet basic standards and maintain the dignity of separate households with consideration of various needs and preferences of different ages, gender, disability groups, including a child-friendly space.lt/pgtltpgtThrough this intervention, SSSD aims to permit at-risk households attain adequate levels of safety, security, privacy, and protection, ltspangtProvide life-sustaining shelter support to 90 lt/spangtltspangthouseholds in lt/spangtltspangtAleppo, 80 in Rural lt/spangtltspangtHama, 80 in Rural Idleb 85 in Rural lt/spangtltspangtLattakia, targeting lt/spangtltspangthouseholds with an average size of 5 individuals each. Through provision of minor repairs to at-risk earthquake-affected households, with structurally safe partially damaged houses. SSSD through a rapid assessment shall identify households residing in minor damaged buildings eligible for minor repair assistance, shall engage households to determine the needed interventions.ltbrgtlt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltspangtSSSD is well positioned to implement this project and is strategically ready to begin activities given SSSD’s ongoing access and presence in the target locations. SSSD is coordinating with the local authorities to begin project activities immediately, due to the emergency nature of the response. All required approvals and evidence of needs to be secured from MoLA, allowing SSSD to intervene in these locations.lt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtltbrgtSSSD is applying for a revision request in order to utilise the Underspending of project’s budget in the implementation of /48/ additional units, making the total number of units /383/ (335+48) increasing the number of beneficiaries from 1675 to /1915/ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgtltpgt
